Back to the board

Patch notes

What has changed in mbrd, newest first. The things worth knowing about, rather than every commit.

49 releases 687 commits since 24 July 2026

  1. 3

    0.597 - 0.599

    Second Try

    5 October 2026

    • A picture that arrived as a plain card can be tried again.
    • NewA picture the browser could not draw when it arrived - a HEIC, a camera RAW, or one you said no to at the size warning - lands as a card with its name and format, and that card now carries a Retry button. One press reads the file again: if it can be drawn now, the card becomes the picture and keeps its place, width, name and tags. If it still cannot, the card stays as it was and says so. Undo turns it back into the plain card.
  2. 11

    0.586 - 0.596

    Elbow Room

    3 October 2026

    • Room to work: a board can push its cards apart, and selecting on a phone stops fighting the finger.

    On the board

    • NewNudge board pushes overlapping cards apart by as little as it takes and keeps the board's shape. It is on the board's right-click menu and beside Rearrange everything in the sidebar. Anchored cards stay put, stuck notes ride along, and a fence too small for its cards grows to hold them.
    • NewA click on a fence's body picks the fence. A drag across it still pans or draws a band, and with something already picked the click only puts that down.
    • NewEvery board in the list has a picture, a board made on another machine, a new board and a fresh install included. The board file now carries its own small picture, and a copy of the app from before today simply does not show it.
    • FixThe sidebar's scrollbar stays up on every tab.

    Sharpness

    • NewAt Full, pictures stay sharp down to 20% and sharpen as you zoom rather than when you let go, with a mouse or trackpad. A touch screen keeps sharpening on release, so a pinch stays smooth.
    • FixA photo zoomed in close no longer blinks blank while its full-size original decodes. The smaller copy stays up until the original is ready.

    On a phone

    • NewWith a card picked, holding a second one starts a group instead of opening the menu, and a drag on bare board pans without dropping the group. Only a tap puts it down. In this mode a tap on a card's controls picks the card rather than playing it or following its link.
    • FasterThe crop frame drags about twice as smoothly.
    • FixA fingertip no longer resizes a small card by accident. Under a finger, the corners stop resizing below 30% zoom and the press moves the card instead. A mouse keeps 15%.
  3. 33

    0.553 - 0.585

    Small Mercies

    2 October 2026

    • Thirty small things that should already have worked. Keys for the tools, undo that says what it did, copies that survive a change of board, and files you can get back out.

    Keys

    • NewEscape during a drag puts the cards back where they started and records nothing.
    • New? opens the keyboard shortcuts.
    • NewShift keeps a dragged card on one line, Shift+F frames the selection, and 1 zooms to 100%.
    • NewKeys for the tools that had none: N writes a note at the pointer, J turns Join on and off, L anchors or lets go, ] and [ bring to front and send to back, and Ctrl+G fences the selection.
    • NewThe Menu key and Shift+F10 open the menu a right-click would.
    • NewCtrl+F opens Find on the board, which now opens on your last search and can select every match at once with Shift+Enter.
    • FixA held arrow key is one undo step, not one per press.

    Picking and editing

    • NewA note's colour can be changed after it is written, from its menu.
    • NewA Select fold on the card menu picks every card of the same kind, everything in a fence, or every card joined to this one.
    • NewThe selected cards' connections can be removed in one step.
    • NewSame width and Same height under Align & distribute size the selection to the card you opened the menu on. A picture keeps its shape.
    • NewDuplicate, copy and cut bring what goes with a card: the notes stuck on it, a fence's contents, and the lines between them.
    • NewA copy made on one board pastes on the next, pictures and all.
    • NewThe viewer steps to the previous and next item with the arrow keys, two buttons at its edges, or a swipe. Enter opens the picked card.

    Undo and messages

    • NewUndo and Redo say what they just did, beside the buttons.
    • NewLarge changes carry an Undo on their message: a cut to the bin, a join, removed connections and a rearrange.
    • NewA message that asks for something carries the button for it - Reload on a new version, Export, Connect, Create tour - and stays up while your pointer or keyboard is on it.
    • NewThe import summary names the files that failed, or offers Show them when every new card landed off screen.

    Files and saving

    • NewA card's own file can be saved, from its menu or the viewer, under the name it arrived with. On a phone it can be sent to another app.
    • NewReplace file… swaps the file a card holds and keeps the card: its place, width, tags and every line and tour stop that names it.
    • NewA card whose file is missing says so with a dashed edge, and mends itself when the file is dropped back in.
    • NewSave image and Save PDF can take only the selection, or one fence.
    • FixA full web shelf asks before it deletes a board to make room, and offers to save a copy first. It used to drop the oldest board silently.
    • FixWhen the browser stops storing the board, the corner says so with a standing Not saved - Export button until it resumes.
    • FixCloud sync waits out an offline spell and pushes again when the connection is back, instead of stopping.

    Around the app

    • NewMedia keys, a headset and the lock screen control the board's music, with the track's title and cover shown by the system.
    • NewA YouTube link keeps its timestamp, and music.youtube.com links play.
    • NewThe browser tab carries the board's name.
    • FixThe phone's Back button closes the open menu or dialog first in the browser and the installed web app, as it already did in the Android app.
    • FixFocus follows the sidebar in and out from the keyboard.

  6. 53

    0.487 - 0.539

    No Dead Weight

    23 September 2026

    • A board file stops growing on every save, and a phone keeps up with a zoom. The rest of the day went on the text editor, most of it on a phone.

    Board files

    • FixSaving a board opened from its file no longer writes its pictures twice. A 388 MB board opened on a phone grew to 653 MB on its first save. The same save now adds 53 KB.
    • FixThe history stops leaving a dead copy of itself in the file. It is kept in pieces of 500 steps, and a save rewrites only the last piece. Once enough of the file is dead, it is written whole again at a quiet moment: after a minute with no edit, as the app closes, or on Save.
    • A board saved now opens in an older copy of the app with its history marked out of date. The board itself opens whole.

    On a phone

    • FasterA zoom in on a phone runs at three times the frame rate, 56 frames a second where it was 17, and a zoom out no longer blinks the board.
    • FixCards stop vanishing for a moment as you zoom out from far in.
    • FasterA zoom out through 25% no longer stutters, and a zoom near 35% no longer stalls. The photographs change to their small copies on the frame the zoom crosses, not after it stops.
    • FixA long pan no longer fills the phone's memory. Every card the board put away as it left the screen stayed in memory, and a few minutes of panning held thousands of them.
    • FasterThe grid's dots cost a fraction of what they did at Softish and Middle, so a zoom on a fast phone drops about a third fewer frames.
    • FasterA board opens faster at Full and Balanced. A photograph is no longer copied again at every start, and one only a little larger than the sharpness limit is shown as it is. A board of 70 photographs spent 4.2 seconds on decoding as it opened, and now spends half a second.
    • FasterA pan or a card drag starts without a hitch, where the first press restyled every card on the board.

    The text editor

    • NewThe page rises in from below as the editor opens, and tips and drops away as it closes.
    • NewOn a phone, every tool sits in two rows at the top of the screen, clear of the keyboard, with the word count and a running session's time above them. The page runs from one edge of the screen to the other.
    • NewA narrow window folds the ribbon rather than scrolling it. The styles become one button, Vomit Mode another, and the small commands lose their words.
    • NewA document may be untitled. Clear its name on the sheet, and the card reads untitled.
    • NewA sticky that grew into a document turns back into a sticky if you cut the text back down to fit while the editor is still open. The note opens with the caret where you deleted.
    • FixThe sheet no longer jumps sideways as a scrollbar arrives.
    • NewA document written back down to fit flies back into its sticky, and a sticky outgrowing itself hands over to its page without a jump.
    • FixA long sticky scrolls inside the composer rather than running off the bottom of the window, and the count of what is left shows only in its last ten characters.
    • FixA paste with a button or a dialog focused no longer lands on the board behind it as a stray .md card.

    Around the app

    • NewThe version at the foot of the sidebar links to these notes, beside a new Privacy link.
    • NewThe browser's install prompt shows two pictures of the app, where it had none.
    • NewArchive and folder cards are drawn as folders, with a look of their own at each whimsy tier.
    • FixSigning in to Drive on the web finishes on a host that drops .html from the address, and the app starts offline again.
    • FixA board pulled from the cloud keeps its look, settings and history.
    • FixOver a hundred smaller repairs from a full read of the code, most of them the readers for unusual file formats refusing a broken file rather than stalling on it.
  7. 22

    0.465 - 0.486

    The Blank Page

    22 September 2026

    • mbrd writes documents now. A text file opens in a word processor of its own, and a sticky that runs long grows into one.

    The text editor

    • NewEdit opens a .md, .txt or .fountain in the text editor, a sheet of paper on a desk across the whole window. The ribbon holds undo, the marks, the paragraph styles, the lists, find and replace, and an outline down the left. The foot counts the words. A file you open and close unchanged is never rewritten.
    • NewThe name at the head of the sheet is the document's name, and a change there renames the card.
    • NewA sticky typed past 120 characters becomes a .md document and grows open into the editor at the caret. Not a keystroke is lost on the way.
    • NewVomit Mode keeps you writing forward. Pick a time from 5 to 60 minutes, and everything before the word you are typing is locked until the time runs out. Backspace works inside the current word and no further. Super locks that word too, 10 seconds after your last key.
    • NewA .fountain screenplay opens in screen mode, on the standard page in Courier. It types like a screenwriting tool: int. starts a scene heading, a name in capitals is followed by dialogue, and Tab changes the element. The foot estimates the pages and the scenes.
    • NewThe editor has its own right-click menu. Shift and right-click still gives the browser's, with its spelling suggestions.
    • NewA double-click still opens a document to read. The text sits on a page as tall as the window and wraps to it. Turn on ASCII art in the editor, and its lines keep their length.
    • Credit where it is due: Vomit Mode is after vomitdraft.com.

    Around the board

    • FixA mouse wheel on Linux zooms again, where Chromium's finer steps read as a touchpad and panned the board. Mouse wheel gains Always zooms, touchpad too, and a window coming back into focus no longer jumps its zoom.
    • NewA link to mbrd shows a new preview picture in chat apps. It is a tenth of the old size, small enough for WhatsApp to show it.

    Print Ready

    21 September 2026

    • An exported picture is sharp enough to print, and a sticky styles its words one at a time.

    Exporting

    • NewSave image and Save PDF ask first. Set the detail in ppi and see the pixel size it comes to, the JPEG quality, a margin in millimetres, and which of the joining lines, the sheet outline, the grid and the paper texture go in. A preview beside the options redraws as you change them.
    • NewAn export is drawn at 300 ppi by default, so an A4 sheet comes out 2480 x 3508, and a PDF page is the board's real size. The JPEG keeps its full colour detail, where the browser's own encoder blurs the colour at every quality.
    • FixAn export carries the board's own paper texture and its shadows, where it had a speckle like static and no shadows at all. Shadows and Card tilt switch them, and a tilted card has clean edges.
    • FixThe title card exports with its name on it, where it was an empty box.

    Sticky notes

    • NewA sticky styles its words, not its lines. Title, font and highlight apply to the words you select, or to what you type next. The highlight is a pen, with the colour at the caret under it. Copy and paste between notes keeps the styles.
    • NewThe composer shows the note exactly as it lands on the board, magnified, with the words wrapping where they will. A new note starts larger, at 160px square, and its type is a step smaller.
    • NewA sticky holds 120 characters. The counter sits in the note's corner and goes red at twenty left. Past the limit it says the note becomes a .md file, and closing the editor makes it one, as one undo step.
    • FixSelect all and then paste in a sticky keeps the paste, where the text went and nothing replaced it.
    • FixSwitching to another window no longer closes the note you are writing.

    On a phone

    • FixThe Android app saves its board files again. A save failed on every board from 0.404 on.
    • FixCheck for updates on the phone always answers. It says it is checking the moment you press it, says so if the check fails, and answers when the update is already downloaded.

    Around the board

    • FixThe corner marks of a selection stay visible past about 160% zoom, where they thinned down to the ring and vanished.
  9. 24

    0.415 - 0.438

    From the Camera

    20 September 2026

    • A photograph draws on the board whatever the camera saved it as. iPhone HEICs and camera RAWs are turned into pictures as they land, and the cards that used to arrive grey and nameless arrive as what they are.

    Photographs

    • NewA .heic or .heif from an iPhone arrives as the picture. The file is read here and the picture inside it decoded by the machine's own decoder, about a fifth of a second for a twelve-megapixel one. Where that decoder is missing, a slower one is fetched instead, so the same file draws on every browser and at every address. A picture the phone stored as a grid of tiles comes back whole and the right way up.
    • NewA camera RAW that baked no preview is developed as it arrives, so a night shot saved as a .dng is a photograph rather than a grey card - and Demosaic, which is offered only on a photograph, is there to develop every pixel of it when you want that.
    • NewThe file you dropped is kept beside the picture, untouched, and Optimize is the one thing that throws it away.
    • FasterOptimize shrinks a HEIC, where it used to count one and then quietly walk past it - often the largest file on a board made on a phone.
    • FixEdit picture opens on a HEIC or a RAW from an older board, where it opened on a blank sheet.

    Around the board

    • FixPlay keeps the board in frame as it replays, so a history that builds a board up is watched rather than happening off the edge of the window.
    • FixSaving a board in Samsung Internet no longer leaves an empty file. Where the browser offers to save and then refuses to write, the board comes down as an ordinary download instead.
    • NewWhat this board weighs says where every file is held - on the board, in the drawer or in the history - as well as what it all comes to.
    • FixThe credits scroll inside their own sheet, which keeps its corners.
    • Maintenance: a release carries Windows and Android. A macOS or Linux copy sees the new version and waits for the next full release, which updates it straight there.

  15. 85

    0.318 - 0.402

    Unpacked

    14 September 2026

    • An archive drops in as one card you can open, the Timeline moved to the foot of the window, and the tour, the fences and the apps' updates were reworked. The rest of the day went on a long list of rough edges.

    Archives and folders

    • NewA ZIP, TAR, 7z, RAR or .gz arrives as one card with an Unzip button. A press puts what was inside on the board in a spiral round where the card sat, in the archive's own order, and one undo takes it back. A folder inside becomes a card with an Open button, which does the same one level down.
    • NewA folder dragged in from Explorer or Finder still spreads its files over the board, but each folder inside it lands as one folder card rather than a flood of loose files.

    The Timeline

    • NewThe Timeline is a bar along the foot of the window, the way a history bar sits under a CAD drawing. It takes its own room rather than covering the board, starts on at a desk and off on a phone, and keeps your choice.
    • NewThe bar is a row of steps with a playhead you drag, and the board follows it. Play walks forward from where you are, the arrow keys go one step at a time, and a gear holds naming, trimming and Hide timeline. The Show timeline box in the Board tab brings it back.
    • FixGoing back and forth in the Timeline no longer loses changes that were never steps, such as the board's title or a setting.
    • FixStepping through the Timeline redraws a card whose look changed, such as a note set to Low opacity, where it kept the look it had.
    • FixPlay lines up with the sidebar's edge, its triangle sits in the middle of the button, and the gear has the outline and ground of a button.
    • NewWhile Play runs, the board is there to watch. A press pans, the tools that would change it are dimmed, and a drop or a paste is turned away with a note that says to press Pause. Only Pause stops a replay, where any press on the page used to.
    • NewDelete timeline in the gear clears the whole history after asking. The board as it stands becomes the start, and the board itself does not change.
    • FixA reload opens at the newest step, where a board left after a few undos came back that many steps behind.
    • FixThe steps scroll a whole step at a time, so no mark is cut in half at either end of the bar, and the scrollbar and the wheel reach the oldest steps.

    The tour

    • NewA board with no tour offers Create tour, and Take the tour and Edit the tour appear once there is one. While you tour or edit, the cards stay where they are: a press picks, a drag pans, and pointing at a stop lights it and fades the rest.
    • NewThe tour bar has two rows, the stop's name and caption over back, forward, the stop's own actions and close. A clip or song alone in a stop plays by itself, and the board's music pauses while you tour. Delete in the editor takes a stop off the tour, with Undo on the note that says so.

    Fences

    • NewA fence can wear one of the four note colours, and roll up to its name bar. Rolled up, the cards inside are hidden and out of reach until it rolls down again, and Find unrolls it when the card it finds is inside.
    • NewA new fence anchors itself ten seconds after you last move it. The anchor and pin badges on a card are buttons now: a press on the anchor lets the card go, and a press on the pin lets the note come away.
    • NewOn the Feed, a fence's name heads its own cards, and fences and loose cards take turns in the board's order rather than every loose card falling to the end.

    • NewA Word file with no picture of itself shows its first page, set from its own text, headings, pictures and tables.

    • NewYour boards are a folder, not a browser's storage. They sit in %APPDATA%/mbrd and its equivalents, and a portable copy keeps them in data beside the program. A browser may clear its own storage to make room; a folder stays where you put it.

    • Mostly a release about what the app does when you touch it: a press that is answered, a menu that leaves the way it came, a board that steps back while you follow a thread across it. Two tools also stopped guessing, and the tour is built somewhere else entirely.

    Touch and menus

    • NewMenus leave the way they arrive. Find, the right-click menu, the toolbar's flyouts, the fence offer and the connection chip all used to appear and then simply vanish. Each plays its way out now, and a flyout opens from the middle of the button that opened it rather than from its corner.

    The tour, and following a thread

    • NewThe tour is built on the board. Every card carries a small square in its corner - a number if it is at that stop, a + if it is not - and a bar along the foot holds the order and a caption for each stop. It used to be a list in a panel covering the third of the board you were picking cards from.
    • NewFollowing a card's threads steps the rest of the board back. Hovering a card used to drop every line that was not its own. The cards those lines reach stay as they are and everything else goes quiet - enough to separate, not enough to hide.
    • FixA connection finds its way around the cards between its ends, where it used to settle on a side before looking and send a line behind a card.
    • FixThe connect tool puts itself down after a pair, with Shift keeping it up. It stayed armed before, which every first-time hand read as the app having got stuck.

    The two tools that stopped guessing

    • NewRemove background finds the subject, rather than filling inwards from the edges against their average colour. A card cut out this way is cut out in the exported picture too.
    • NewCAD files draw properly. .iges and .igs are read at all now, and they and .step go through a real CAD kernel rather than this app's own reading of their surfaces, so a curved part arrives curved.

    • NewSave keeps the board in this browser, and Export writes a file you can put somewhere.
